column1: # OpenVerify nickname table, reviewed Wikidata pairs (plan C58.3, decision 32). Wikidata is CC0.
# The candidates come from nicknames.sparql, run once against the endpoint below. The reviewer
# read every Latin-script candidate and kept only diminutives used in the language given here
# (the query's labels are mostly language "mul"), rejecting translations, spelling variants and
# nickname-to-nickname links, which P460 ("said to be the same as") also makes. The result file
# is not committed; its SHA-256 lets a saved copy be checked (build-nicknames.ts --wikidata-result).
